Aisha (AE): Quick sync: FinServ POC — need final decision on hosting mode and region, list of success criteria for evals, and answers for two security Qs. Can we close by EOD?
Priya (SE): I'm free in 30. My preference is Dedicated (predictable throughput) unless they need on-prem for residency.
Tom (CSE): +1 Dedicated unless customer insists on VPC. What's their latency target / 95th p99?
Aisha (AE): They want <=200ms p95 for our chat endpoint with 1k concurrent users during peak. Budget prefers hosted but compliance may push private.
Miguel (Solutions): For that latency we should run on A100-ish Dedicated or hosted in eu-west-1 with optimistic batching. If Private, need on-prem GPU spec and network egress plan.
Priya (SE): Quick eval plan: 1) baseline prompts (20 prompts) 2) throughput run (1k conc) 3) regression evals on 50 prompts. Pass = <=200ms p95 and <3% quality regressions vs baseline.
Jordan (Security): Two items from their questionnaire: a) customer-managed KMS? b) SIEM/log shipping? We support KMS for Private & Dedicated and have syslog/S3 exports for enterprise tiers. Also need to confirm retention windows.
Aisha (AE): Can we produce a short Q&A doc for the customer's security team (KMS, retention, access controls)? They also asked about data residency and certifications.
Tom (CSE): Will draft the security answers. Also pricing note: Dedicated has monthly commit tiers — if they commit >= 3 nodes-month we can include extended retention and reduced token pricing.
Miguel (Solutions): Region rec: customer requires EU residency — recommend eu-west-1 for Hosted/Dedicated. For Private they'll need to provision a VPC in their EU region.
DeployBot: infra: project-finserv-poc template v2 created -> https://redwood.internal/infra/finserv-poc (ops ticket FIN-412).
Priya (SE): Action items: @Tom draft security 1-pager, @Miguel produce perf & cost estimate (Hosted vs Dedicated @1k conc), @Aisha confirm if customer can provision VPC for Private. I'll schedule a 30m call at 15:00 to finalize.
Aisha (AE): Thanks — if we get the docs before 15:00 we can lock mode + SOW approach. :thumbsup:
Tom (CSE): Got it, I'll ping when the draft is up.
Miguel (Solutions): ETA for cost/perf estimate: 90m.
Jordan (Security): I'll review the draft once Tom posts it.
Aisha (AE): Perfect, appreciate the quick turnaround.
